Cc: Jorge Silva <jorge.silva@clearwave-ap.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: Vendor onboarding & PO remit details for Redwood

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the call earlier. We're ready to start vendor onboarding for Redwood so we can push POs through our AP portal. Two quick items to confirm before we create your supplier record:

- Remittance name and address we should populate on invoices (we need legal entity name and registered address).
- VAT handling: ClearWave needs to know if Redwood will invoice with an EU VAT number or will be treated as VAT-exempt under reverse-charge (we're in Spain and the buyer-side reverse-charge applies for B2B in many categories).

I've attached our standard vendor intake spreadsheet (clearwave_vendor_form.xlsx). If you can return that with the fields filled, I'll submit it for a supplier ID.

Separately, procurement asked if Redwood can accept net-60 payment terms but with an escrow mandate for the first two invoices (ClearWave's policy for new strategic vendors). Is that something your finance team would consider? If so, we'll generate a DocuSign envelope to capture the escrow mandate.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearWave Logistics
elena.morales@clearwave.com

Attachment: clearwave_vendor_form.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T13:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & PO remit details for Redwood

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear checklist and for walking through this on the call.

Quick answers below and next steps:

1) Legal entity / remit address to use on invoices:
   - Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Billing / remit address (EU AP preferred): Redwood Inference EU SARL, 4 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France
   - VAT: Redwood Inference EU SARL VAT ID: FR12 345678901 (we can provide registration cert).

2) VAT handling: We are VAT-registered in the EU and will invoice with our EU VAT number by default. If ClearWave prefers reverse-charge (no VAT on the invoice), we can generate invoices without VAT when you provide a valid buyer VAT number and the completed EU reverse-charge declaration. Please confirm which approach you prefer so we map the invoice lines correctly.

3) Net-60 + escrow: We're open to the net-60 terms; the escrow mandate is a new ask for us. Finance would like to review the proposed escrow agreement prior to signing. Could you share the draft or a sample DocuSign? We typically request limited escrow scope (first two invoices up to EUR 250k total) and a two-week release window after invoice approval.

4) Attached: I've included a short vendor onboarding packet (redwood_onboarding_packet.pdf) that lists our preferred PO/PO-number matching text for invoices, remittance email, and who to contact for tax forms. Please confirm: ClearWave requires PO number on the invoice header and line-level PO matching?

Next steps we propose: you submit the completed clearwave_vendor_form.xlsx, we'll upload it to our portal and return any requested tax docs, and your AP team generates the DocuSign for the escrow draft. If you want a call to walk procurement and AP through the packet, Marissa and Laura are on copy and can join.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_packet.pdf (6 pages, 48KB)

From: Jorge Silva <jorge.silva@clearwave-ap.com>

Date: 2027-03-15T08:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & PO remit details for Redwood

Hi Sofia — thanks, this is helpful. A couple clarifications from the AP side: 

- We do require a PO number on the invoice header; line-level matching is optional but helps with split-POs. If you can include PO number in the invoice header and as an invoice field ("PO No."), that will be ideal.
- DocuSign link for the escrow mandate: https://app.docusign.com/clearwave/CW-045 (we'll send the envelope after we have your tax docs). The escrow template is standard and limits the escrow to new-vendor onboarding for the first two invoices or 90 days, whichever comes first.

Elena is returning the filled vendor form in her next email — she also requested a scanned copy of your EU VAT registration certificate and a W-8BEN-E/W-9 for tax classification (even though EU entity should be W-8? — please provide whichever is appropriate for Redwood EU SARL).

I'll also kick off a supplier-record request; once that's created you'll receive a supplier ID and an automated welcome email from the vendor portal (no-reply@clearwave-ap.com).

Jorge Silva
AP Operations Manager
ClearWave Logistics
vendor-portal@clearwave-ap.com

Attachment: none
